article_title: OpenAI fires three workers over mishandling 'sensitive information'

tasks.prompt: What is the main reason OpenAI gave for dismissing the three researchers?
options: They mishandled sensitive company information outside established procedures.
They publicly demanded a pause in all AI development.
They refused to attend a White House technology meeting.
They caused a financial loss by cancelling a model launch.
tasks.correct_answer: They mishandled sensitive company information outside established procedures.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: OpenAI מסרה שהעובדים טיפלו במידע רגיש מחוץ לנהלים ובכך הפרו את מדיניות החברה ואת האמון.

tasks.prompt: What did the BBC say about why the former employees were not dismissed?
options: For working with safety researchers
For warning more than 100 organisations
For raising concerns about AI safety
For reviewing the activity of AI agents
tasks.correct_answer: For raising concerns about AI safety
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, הם לא פוטרו משום שהעלו חששות בטיחותיים, אלא בשל הטיפול הנטען במידע רגיש.

tasks.prompt: In the article, what does “autonomously” mean when describing AI agents?
options: Only after a human writes every step
With no connection to the internet
By copying another company’s model
By carrying out tasks independently from simple instructions
tasks.correct_answer: By carrying out tasks independently from simple instructions
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת סוכני AI שמבצעים משימות באופן עצמאי על בסיס הוראות פשוטות.

tasks.prompt: What did OpenAI say being notified about an AI-related incident did not necessarily mean?
options: That private information was accessed or a system was compromised
That the organisation used an OpenAI product
That the incident was reported to the US president
That the organisation had external safety researchers
tasks.correct_answer: That private information was accessed or a system was compromised
tasks.explanation_hebrew: OpenAI הבהירה שעצם קבלת ההודעה אינה מוכיחה שמידע פרטי נחשף או שמערכת נפרצה.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article mention the Hugging Face breach and attacks on government websites?
options: To show why OpenAI has faced stronger scrutiny over AI-agent safety
To prove the dismissed researchers planned the attacks
To explain why Hugging Face hired the researchers
To show that every notified organisation lost private data
tasks.correct_answer: To show why OpenAI has faced stronger scrutiny over AI-agent safety
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האירועים מובאים כרקע לבחינה הציבורית הגוברת של הסיכונים והפיקוח על סוכני AI.

tasks.prompt: What does “morally binding” suggest about the agreement announced after the White House meeting?
options: It was a criminal law with prison penalties.
It was limited to government websites.
It relied mainly on a voluntary ethical commitment.
It required every AI company to stop research.
tasks.correct_answer: It relied mainly on a voluntary ethical commitment.
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מצביע על התחייבות מוסרית ולא בהכרח על חוק אכיף, ולכן מומחים ביקרו את ההסתמכות על רגולציה עצמית.

tasks.prompt: Name the outside group involved in the work and state what that group does.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: תשובה מלאה תציין שמדובר בארגון חיצוני להערכת AI ותסביר שהוא מנתח או מעריך מודלים של בינה מלאכותית.
expected_points: An external AI evaluation organisation was involved.
It analyses or evaluates artificial-intelligence models.

tasks.prompt: Summarise in two sentences how the dismissals connect to the wider debate about AI safety.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לקשר בין הטיפול במידע והפיטורים לבין הדיון הרחב בסוכנים אוטונומיים, תקריות פריצה והצורך בפיקוח.
expected_points: OpenAI said three workers violated information-handling policies.
The case occurred amid scrutiny of autonomous agents and calls for stronger AI safeguards or oversight.

tasks.prompt: Why might critics consider the White House agreement insufficient protection against AI risks? Use one detail from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר שההסכם מאפשר בעיקר רגולציה עצמית או שאינו פיקוח חיצוני מחייב, ולתמוך בפרט מהכתבה.
expected_points: The agreement was described as morally binding rather than clearly enforceable.
Experts criticised it because AI companies could regulate themselves.

tasks.prompt: Write a short paragraph explaining why careful handling of sensitive information matters in AI safety research.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח פסקה עניינית המקשרת סודיות, אמון ארגוני, נהלים וסיכון אפשרי למערכות או לארגונים.
expected_points: Sensitive information can expose systems, organisations, or safety work to risk.
Following procedures protects trust and enables responsible investigation or oversight.
